messages:
Ashley (sales): Prospect (regional bank) asked for a concise POC showing BYO-KMS/HSM integration. They need perf impact, sample egress cost, firewall rules, and answers for their security questionnaire.
Ben (platform): BYO adds an auth+network hop on unwraps. Ballpark latency delta 10-40ms depending on RTT. Mitigate with a DEK sidecar cache and short TTL.
Claire (crypto): Compliance check: FIPS attestation? dual-custody? If they require HSM ceremonies, add lead time and SOW items. Recommend DEK cache: TTL 5m, LRU cap per-tenant (eg 1000), and cache sealing on restart.
Devon (solutions): I'll build a tiny perf harness and provide a curl example they can run from their infra. Suggest 1k requests, concurrency 8, capture p50/p95. We can offer a 60m on-call window to debug live.
Ashley (sales): Pricing: they want an expected per-req uplift. How do we show this simply to procurement?
Ben (platform): Present connector as one-time setup fee + ops estimate. Example calc: if KMS charges $0.03 per 10k unwraps => ~$0.30 per 100k. Add egress if cross-region. We'll label as estimate and tie to POC numbers.
Claire (crypto): Add rotation/revocation notes: KEK rotation per-customer (monthly/quarterly), DEK rotation staggered to avoid cache churn. Provide a short revocation playbook for the questionnaire.
Ben (platform): For network diagram: outbound HTTPS (443) to their KMS IPs; optional mTLS. I'll draft iptables snippets and a one-pager with common cloud HSM endpoints.
ops-bot: Ticket created: #SUP-2210 assigned Devon (solutions)  POC planner due in 72h.
Ashley (sales): Action list: Devon -> perf harness + instructions; Ben -> ports/iplist + cost sensitivity table; Claire -> compliance checklist + rotation FAQ. I'll collate and send to the prospect.
